items.title: How to Navigate the Next Wave of AI Competition
items.summary: OpenAI cutting Cursor off after the SpaceX acquisition looks like lab-war psychodrama — until you line it up with Windsurf, the xAI blocks, and Satya Nadella's reverse information paradox. The pattern is clear: the sovereignty conversation enterprises have been having about models now has to extend to harnesses too.

items.title: Trump Jr’s fund 1789 Capital leads a $1bn round valuing Polymarket at $21bn
items.summary:

He is also a strategic adviser to Kalshi, Polymarket’s principal competitor. 1789 Capital is putting about $300m into a round of roughly $1bn that values Polymarket at $21bn, Forbes reported. Other investors in the round have not been named. items.title: The next cybersecurity battleground is inside the processor
items.summary:
Cybersecurity has a location problem. Attackers often exploit vulnerabilities in systems that businesses have spent years protecting with software, yet the processor at the center of those systems can remain largely unaware of anything that is wrong. Verizon’s 2026 Data Breach Investigations Report found vulnerability exploitation had become the leading initial access vector, accounting for […]

items.title: Micron’s Taiwan unions are heading for a strike vote over bonuses
items.summary:
Roughly 10,000 Micron workers in Taiwan are represented by two unions that are now preparing their members for a possible strike. About 80% of workers polled in a preliminary survey supported industrial action, Reuters reported on Tuesday. The dispute is about bonuses rather than base pay, and more specifically about how those bonuses are calculated. […]
